title: IT — Flash Loan + CREATE2 mintToPoolIfNeeded Logic Flaw Analysis
root_cause: A reserve calculation flaw in the `mintToPoolIfNeeded()` function causes pre-deposited balances at a CREATE2-predicted address to be treated as legitimate reserves, enabling excessive minting through a 9-iteration swap cycle
steps: → [1] Pre-compute Money contract address via CREATE2
→ [2] Transfer USDT to predicted address (before deployment)
→ [5] hack() recurses 9 times: repeatedly triggers mintToPoolIfNeeded()
